title: Star Wars Jedi Fallen Order Dark Temple #5 Marvel 2020 Final Issue Cere Junda
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Star Wars: Jedi: Fallen Order - Dark Temple #5 of 5 (2020), Marvel Comics - final issue of the prequel to the Jedi: Fallen Order video game, starring Cere Junda. Written by Matthew Rosenberg, art by Paolo Villanelli, colors by Arif Prianto, Joe Coleman credited on the cover. $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Joywave "Obsession" ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
